list: The official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are written in the entrant's own words from those descriptions; every guide cites its source.
source_note: Source for every trophy's requirement: the official trophy description, PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026). How-to steps are the entrant's own reading of that description, not copied from any guide.
missable_rule: MISSABLE means the trophy is tied to one story beat, one mission or one choice: do it on your first pass. Story missions can be replayed from the pause menu where the game offers it — that replay is the safety net, not the plan. Everything else is repeatable in free roam.
online: No online trophies in the official list: 0 of 55 need online play.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this unlocks automatically — it is last by definition. Follow the roadmap stages in order (story, strangers, activities, cleanup, money and 100%) and the platinum falls last.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missable_note: Opening story mission — do it on your first pass.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to the end. It is the first story beat, so it unlocks naturally as you play — there is no way to skip it, just finish it.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missable_note: Chapter finale — finish the chapter before moving on.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1, in story order. Keep a save from before the chapter finale in case a side objective is missed — the chapter trophy only lands when the chapter is done.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missable_note: Chapter finale — finish the chapter before moving on.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2, in story order. As with Chapter 1, clear the chapter's named missions and any stranger strands that open along the way before the finale.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missable_note: Chapter finale — finish the chapter before moving on.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3, in story order. By now the map is open — use the gaps between missions to start stranger strands and activities, then close the chapter.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missable_note: Chapter finale — finish the chapter before moving on.
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, in story order. This is the last chapter before the finale: sweep up any missable-tagged mission trophies now, before the final mission.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missable_note: Final mission — clear every other missable trophy first.
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Do the missable-tagged mission trophies first: after the finale some story moments may no longer be reachable, so clear roadmap stages 1 and 2 before you start it.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission — play it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a named story mission, so play it when it appears and finish it; mission replay from the pause menu is the fallback if the game offers it.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission — play it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. A heist mission: follow the plan the game lays out, finish the job, and the trophy lands with the mission complete screen.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission — play it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Play it when the story offers it and finish it — like every named mission trophy, it is tied to that one mission.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission — play it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. Finish the mission as the story presents it; the trophy is the mission-complete reward, nothing extra to collect.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission — play it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Finish the takedown the mission asks for; the trophy lands when the mission ends.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missable_note: Named story mission — play it when it appears.
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the operation as the story presents it — it is a mission-complete trophy, so completion is the whole requirement.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: every story mission, stranger strand, activity, collectible set and challenge the game counts. This is the long grind — leave it to stage 5 and use this guide's counts (250 stunts, 42 range challenges, 14 drone races, 100 vehicles, 52 areas) as your checklist.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, airtime and drifts all count toward the total. Chain them during free roam between missions; the counter is cumulative, so a few at a time is fine.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Work through the activities in stage 3 — one attempt at each is enough, no win required.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Practice one range at a time and start with the easiest weapon class; gold needs accuracy and speed, so learn the target pattern before pushing for time.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations. Learn each course's gates on a practice run, then race to win — a win at all 14 is required, not just one.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Enter a new race type or location each time — repeats of the same race do not add to the 20.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish the challenge spot, watch the line tension and reel when it slackens; beating Cal once is enough.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Pick the shortest cabinet you find and play it through — completion, not a high score, is what counts.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missable_note: Strand finale — finish Andy's strand before the story moves past it.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's last mission to close his strand. Stranger strands can move on as the story advances, so take Andy's missions whenever they appear rather than leaving them to the end.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missable_note: Strand finale — finish Kenton's strand before the story moves past it.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's last mission to close his strand. Take his missions as they appear; a strand left unfinished while the story advances may not wait for you.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missable_note: Strand finale — finish Billy's strand before the story moves past it.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's last mission to close his strand. Keep his missions current as you play the story — strands are finished in order, one mission at a time.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Strands can become unavailable as the story advances — start every stranger you meet.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Talk to every stranger you meet and follow each strand to its end — 8 finished strands is the count, and Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missable_note: Strand finale — finish Randy's strand before the story moves past it.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's last mission to close his strand. Take his missions as they appear so the strand is done well before the final mission.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missable_note: Strand finale — finish Tyrone's strand before the story moves past it.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's last mission to close his strand. Like every stranger finale, it is done when you play the strand through — do not leave it until after the story ends.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Visit them during exploration in stage 4; each spot counts once, so tick them off as you go.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missable_note: One-of-a-kind hunt — do it when Bret's strand offers it.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Follow Bret's strand until he marks the hunt, then track the animal and take the shot — the animal is one of a kind, so do it when the strand offers it.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are found across Leonida — finish one full set, then two more; only a completed set counts toward the 3.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app at each new spot you visit and log it — the count is cumulative across the whole map, so log as you explore.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges stack up from missions, activities and free-roam feats; keep playing the full game and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it. Get the heat in open country where you can break line of sight, then hide until the stars clear — your partner must be with you when it clears.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Hit three shops in one run while the stars stay up — plan a short route between nearby shops and keep moving.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter each new vehicle once; the count covers the whole roster, so try everything you find parked or driving by.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group, trigger Combat Focus and chain the five before it ends — a crowded fight is the place to try it.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — leave the airport your own way instead of boarding a flight. Any runway exit in a vehicle counts as leaving unscheduled; pick a quiet moment with low heat.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks. Take one on with heavy weapons or hijack it; the trophy is about the tanks, so find them where the army responds and finish the encounter.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet — no alarms, no one spotting you — and get out clean; if you are seen, leave and try another store.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Plan each vault, grab the take and break away clean — five escapes is the count, and each one needs a getaway, not just the robbery.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Stop a truck on a quiet road, take the cash and lose the heat — one clean escape is all it takes.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive through every named area on the map; the counter fills as new areas are discovered, so sweep the map region by region in stage 4.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Hit one operation per gang across Leonida — nine gangs, nine robberies, each one counts once.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Sit down at a beach bar on Ocean Beach and order the cocktail — a quiet moment, do it whenever you are passing.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom front — pick a showroom, build speed outside and go straight through.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Play a full game of bowling at that alley — finishing the game is what counts.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. Play through a partner moment that draws a crowd — keep playing the story with your partner and this lands on its own.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missable_note: Choice trophy — a choice cannot be unmade without reloading a save.
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse. Make story choices as they come — this tracks decisions, so it is the one trophy you cannot grind: play the story and choose. A save from before a big choice lets you see both sides.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Fail something, then succeed on the retry — it is a second-attempt trophy, so it comes naturally when a tough mission takes two tries.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missable_note: One-off strange event — stop and watch when the world does something weird.
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Witness something strange in Leonida — a one-off odd event out in the world. Keep an eye out while exploring; these moments do not wait, so stop and watch when the world does something weird.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Hit someone with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — line up a slow pass and swing as you go by.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Feed marked bills to your contacts over time until $250,000 is clean — it is a running total, so launder whenever you have bills.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, weapons, food and gear — every shop purchase counts toward the total, so spend as you play.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy every garage on the market; save up in stage 5 and buy them as you can afford them.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register ten different vehicles in the app — one entry per vehicle.
trophies.source: Official description · PlayStation trophy list via Exophase & PSNProfiles (18 Nov 2026)
